settings.text: Digitize your loose negatives, slides, prints, or tapes with our high resolution archiving services. Perfect for preserving family memories.

Thanks to Coastal Film Lab’s Digitizing Box, deciding how to preserve your family memories is simpler than ever before.  We’re giving you access to high-end digitizing services typically reserved for museums and fine artists at a price you can afford, with straightforward pricing, and no expensive upcharges or surprises when it gets to us.

Our detailed, color-accurate scanning process converts analog memories into digital files you can access, share, and enjoy for years to come. Whether you’re preserving a family photo archive, restoring vintage film negatives, or converting VHS, Hi8, and MiniDV tapes into modern formats; our trusted archiving service brings your moments back with the clarity and care they deserve. Let us help you protect your legacy with professional digitization, secure delivery, and a future-proof asset you’ll treasure.

For freshly shot, undeveloped film, please see our Film Processing Page.

Film Scanning

Already have developed negatives? Our Scan Only service transforms them into high-quality digital files, providing accurate colors, beautiful tones, and a seamless way to preserve and share your film photography.

What We Offer:

Professional Scanning: We carefully scan your negatives using industry-leading equipment, ensuring every frame is color-accurate and true to your film’s unique character. Each image is individually color-corrected to deliver stunning results.

Tailored Scanning Options: Whether your film requires vibrant, high-contrast scans or a softer, natural look, our equipment and expertise provide flexibility to suit your creative style.

Quality Assurance: All scans go through a thorough quality control process to ensure sharpness, proper exposure, and consistent color accuracy.

Convenient Digital Delivery: Once scanned, your files are securely uploaded to a Google Drive folder, and a download link is emailed directly to you for fast and easy access.

Tape Digitization

Have old tapes sitting in storage? Our Tape Digitization service converts your VHS, MiniDV, Hi8, and other analog formats into high-quality digital files, ensuring your memories are safe, accessible, and easy to share.

What We Offer:

Digitization: We use high-quality equipment to carefully transfer your tapes into a digital format, preserving the original details while enhancing clarity and stability.

Thorough Quality Control: We review each transfer to ensure smooth playback and the best possible image and sound quality.

Convenient Digital Delivery: Once digitized, your videos are securely uploaded to a Google Drive folder, and a direct download link is emailed to you for easy access.

Preservation & Sharing: Enjoy your digitized memories on modern devices and share them with family and friends without the risk of degradation over time.

Print Scanning

Give your old prints new life with our Print Scanning service: a high-quality, professional way to preserve, restore, and share your cherished memories in digital format.

What We Offer:

High-Resolution Scanning: We use a high-megapixel digital camera and professional lighting to capture every detail of your printed photos with incredible clarity.

Color & Exposure Correction: Each scan is carefully adjusted to restore accurate colors, improve contrast, and remove minor imperfections.

Quality Assurance: We inspect every scan to ensure sharpness, proper alignment, and the best possible digital reproduction of your photos.

Convenient Digital Delivery: high-quality scans are uploaded to a Google Drive folder, with a direct download link emailed to you for easy access.

Preserve & Share: Digitized prints allow you to keep your memories safe, make reprints, or easily share them with family and friends.
